## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Mixed leadership confirms the neutral call: Tech strength (XLK (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +20.06%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND) vs Energy and Financials lagging (XLE (1W: -4.80% | 1M: -4.64%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; Financials sector 1W: -0.23% | 1M: -0.43% BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress modestly easing: HYG (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +0.75%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.97%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Volatility dropping: VXX (1W: -7.90% | 1M: -16.82%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND, reducing tactical hedging demand.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +0.44%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while UUP shows short-term correction (UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +0.18%) ↓ falling CORRECTION), so rates/dollar not forcing a clear tilt.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech-led: XLK (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +20.06%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND with semis/tech ETFs SOXX (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +26.47%) ABOVE TREND and IGV (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +20.31%) ABOVE TREND. Style: Growth showing strength but leadership mixed given weak Energy and Financials.

5. US vs Global?  
US and broader EM participation: SPY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.31%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +9.43%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. China lagging: FXI (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.55%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative risk-on pockets: ARKK (1W: +6.96% | 1M: +11.45%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +6.74%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, but crypto pullback persists: IBIT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: -2.62%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals constructive: CPER (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) → flat ABOVE TREND; copper supports cyclical tone. Gold muted in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +0.03% | 1M: -0.07%) → flat RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy bifurcated and weak overall: XLE (1W: -4.80% | 1M: -4.64%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and oil ETFs BNO/USO deeply BELOW TREND, while natural gas outperformance UNG (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +17.54%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad US/Tech momentum — SPY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.31%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +11.60%) ABOVE TREND, XLK ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Energy and China remain BELOW TREND and sector breadth is only 5/11, so momentum is concentrated, not broad.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to tech/semis and select cyclical areas showing strength (XLK, SOXX, IGV); reduce exposure to energy and lagging China names (XLE, FXI) and monitor volatility/VXX for shifts in risk appetite.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology/semis (XLK (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +20.06%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +26.47%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy (XLE (1W: -4.80% | 1M: -4.64%) BELOW TREND) and commodity oil ETFs (BNO/USO BELOW TREND).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Natural gas and copper (UNG (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +17.54%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Brent/oil complex (BNO (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -13.98%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency gauge); HYG/LQD spread near parity (HYG (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.97%) ABOVE TREND) for credit health; XLK/ XLE relative pivot to confirm leadership change.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, mixed signals between strong tech and weak energy/financials. Tech and semis showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +20.06%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +26.47%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk is concentrated weakness in energy and China (XLE (1W: -4.80% | 1M: -4.64%) BELOW TREND; FXI (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND) — watch breadth and VXX for regime tilt.
